tagRulesets.describedAs: creation — maintainers only, so the release ceremony can push a tag

protection — immutable for everyone, maintainers included. bypassActors is "unchecked", not "forbidden": GitHub omits bypass_actors entirely for a caller without repository write access, and the verify job runs with contents:read, so an empty list and a populated one are indistinguishable to it. Emptying the list does not change that — the field stays invisible. Verified empty by hand on 2026-10-26 (Settings → Rules → Rulesets → protection → Bypass list); re-verify there whenever this ruleset is edited, because nothing in CI will catch it being repopulated.
